text: Let’s keep going with the slope of a curve.

propositions.name: Average rate
propositions.statement: The average rate of change over an interval is the change in output divided by the change in input.

propositions.name: Secant slope
propositions.statement: The slope of the secant line through two points of a curve equals the average rate of change between them.

propositions.name: Instantaneous rate
propositions.statement: The instantaneous rate of change is the limit of average rates as the interval shrinks to a single point.

propositions.name: Derivative
propositions.statement: The derivative at a point is the instantaneous rate of change of the function there.
